title: Build a usable session without confusing support for permission
description: Choose a server and a host policy. The handshake reveals protocol support; the host policy decides connection trust, model exposure, and approval gates.

primitives.label: Resources
primitives.detail: List and read addressable context after URI and access checks.

primitives.label: Prompts
primitives.detail: Retrieve reusable templates after explicit user selection.

primitives.label: Tools
primitives.detail: Let the model request functions while the host retains execution control.

servers.label: Verified documentation service
servers.detail: A reviewed remote server that returns public and workspace documentation.
trustSignals: Owner and deployment endpoint are verified
OAuth resource and audience are pinned
Resource URIs and returned content are still validated

servers.label: Pinned local workspace helper
servers.detail: A configured stdio server with read tools and one file-writing tool.
trustSignals: Executable and package version are pinned
Process receives a bounded environment and workspace
Host inventory classifies the write tool independently
missingSignals: Tool annotations do not replace host review

servers.label: Unknown automation endpoint
servers.detail: A remote server discovered from an unverified link that advertises broad actions.
trustSignals: The endpoint can complete an MCP handshake
missingSignals: No verified owner or reviewed deployment
No trusted tool inventory or data-handling agreement
No approved OAuth resource or downstream credential boundary

servers.label: Future-revision laboratory server
servers.detail: A test endpoint that responds with a protocol revision the host does not support.

policies.label: Inspect only
policies.detail: Connect to inspect low-risk context, but keep tools away from the model.

policies.label: Bounded assistance
policies.detail: Require a reviewed server; expose useful primitives but gate writes per call.
policies.approval: Consent before calls; fresh review for writes

policies.label: Action-ready workflow
policies.detail: Require verified provenance and allow reviewed side effects with visible approval.
